```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-IDm
#| tbl-cap: "Material scenarios representative of tailings storage facilities (TSF) and waste rock dumps (WRD)  used in Newmark displacement and fundamental-period analyses, with slope material classifications per the Unified Soil Classification System (USCS)"

IDm <- c("U1", "U2", "U3", "U4", "U5", "U6", "U7", "U8")
USCS <- c(
  "ML MH",
  "SP SM",
  "SP SM ML MH",
  "GP GW",
  "GP GW SP SM",
  "GP GW ML MH",
  "CL CH",
  "CL CH ML MH"
)
TSF_Zone <- c(
  "Fine Tailings (Slimes, Pond)",
  "Coarse Tailings Beach / Upstream Shell",
  "Transitional Zone (Beach Margin / Intermediate Tailings)",
  "Rockfill Buttress / Downstream Shell",
  "Downstream Shell with Granular Filter or Transition Layer",
  "Downstream Shell with Fines-Enriched Transition / Filter",
  "Core Zone (Impervious Core / Cutoff Trench)",
  "Core Zone with Silty-Clay Transition (Core Margin / Fine Fill)"
)

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  IDm = IDm,
  USCS = USCS,
  "TSF Zone" = TSF_Zone
)

# For Quarto rendering (flextable pipeline):
TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
)
TBL <- flextable::set_table_properties(TBL, layout = "autofit")
TBL

```
